mapper.select: select ut1.tag_name as common_name from (select tag_name from user_tag where uid = #{uid}) ut1 inner join (select tag_name from user_tag where uid = #{vid}) ut2 on ut1.tag_name = ut2.tag_name;

SELECT t.tag_name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM user_tag t INNER JOIN danmu d ON t.uid = d.uid WHERE d.vid = #{vid} AND d.status = 1 AND t.tag_name != '低质量弹幕倾向' AND t.tag_name != '短平快弹幕' GROUP BY t.tag_name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 8;
